contentBody.question: What is Shared Life?
contentBody.answer:
Shared Life is where neighbours share what is happening in their lives. Tap the + button and choose Share in Shared Life (share something), then pick a type:

  • Thank You - Name someone who showed up
  • Neighbourhood Moment - Something small worth sharing
  • Grace Moment - A quiet miracle you didn't see coming
  • Heavy Heart - Share what's hard, you're not alone
  • Good News - Share a win or a milestone
  • Introduction - Introduce yourself to neighbours

Your post appears in the Home feed for neighbours to read and respond to.
